name: OpenAI (voice + image)
purpose: Voice (speech-to-text and text-to-speech) and image generation. Text features use Claude (NN-CLAUDE).

tasks.title: Create a project and scoped key per client build
steps: One OpenAI project per client build
Restrict the key to the audio and image endpoints only
tasks.doneWhen: Key cannot call endpoints outside voice and image.

tasks.title: Set budget limits and keep the key server-side
steps: Monthly budget and alert threshold on the project
Call the API only from server routes
tasks.doneWhen: Budget is set; the client bundle contains no key.

tasks.title: Wire voice input and output
steps: Speech-to-text for voice input; text-to-speech for spoken replies
Ask for microphone permission only when the user starts recording
Do not store audio after transcription unless the client asks
tasks.doneWhen: A voice note becomes text, and a reply can be played back.

tasks.title: Wire image generation
steps: Generate on the server and save results to Supabase Storage (NN-SUPABASE)
Apply moderation to prompts before generating
tasks.doneWhen: Generated images are stored and served from Storage.

tasks.title: Test voice and image fallbacks
steps: Playwright checks that the UI handles a missing key or API error cleanly (NN-PLAYWRIGHT-03)
tasks.doneWhen: Features degrade gracefully with OPENAI_API_KEY unset.
